natural.excludedClaim: Lung is supplied-state coverage unless a separately recorded public route actually reaches it.

recorder.enemyTransitions: rAF-observed logical state changes only; point observations, not continuous enemy animation
recorder.overflow: Stop recorder and reject completeness; never silently discard player/tool frames
recorder.encoding: UTF-8 NDJSON, incrementally drained and checked; catalogue records precede their dynamic references

natural.enemySamplingBoundary: Whole-scene enemy/native geometry is sampled at100ms plus observed transition points. Only player/tool records remain continuous rAF; enemy transient continuity is not inferred.

humanReviewRequired: eight-direction sector/heading clarity without a conflicting fixed painted pose
contract.finalPerformance: Separate exclusive natural 48-body standard/low desktop/compact run; no FPS claim from this video/diagnostic-heavy capture.
contract.singleFrameBoundary: Each enemy hurt/dissolve group has one authored key frame, plus its actual timed visual response. These are never reported as authored multi-frame animations.

selectedBuild.publicationStatus: Not inferred; this may be a candidate build.

derived.scope: Actual Renderer; explicitly supplied state/clock/positions/ownership/actions. No simulation steps or natural reachability claim.
